summary: CyberloQ Technologies filed an 8-K reporting two routine items: amended, restated and consolidated promissory notes with all convertible-note holders, and a Nevada charter amendment creating a dual-class structure. The Restated Notes consolidate principal, carry no ordinary interest from September 1, 2026 through September 1, 2028, mature September 1, 2028, and bear 12% default interest thereafter; accrued interest through August 31, 2026 converts at $0.10 per share, terminating prior conversion rights. The charter amendment authorizes 300 million Class A voting and 200 million Class B non-voting shares, redesignating existing common as Class A. No special situation.
